independent_recomputation.reimplemented_pipeline: read both CSVs -> lower/strip username key -> per-user mention_count=SUM, follower_count=MAX -> inner join -> directed edges s->u: k=min(mention,10), k distinct sources sampled without replacement weighted by follower_count (rng=default_rng(42), sorted node order) -> PageRank alpha=0.85, weight=mention/k, tol 1e-10

observations_and_risks: PageRank values rest on a SYNTHETIC graph: no observed interaction log links specific users, so in-edges are simulated from mention counts and follower-weighted sampling; the scores measure simulated attention flow, not verified real influence.

Ranking covers only the 2694 users present in both sources (inner join); 6753 twitter-only and 37872 bot-only users are excluded, so this is not a global leaderboard. Users with mention_count=0 (283 nodes) have zero in-degree and are ranked purely by damping redistribution.

Seed sensitivity: an independent seed-7 draw under the same recipe changes every source selection and yields 0/10 overlap with the reported top-10 (upstream sensitivity files report 4/10 and Spearman 0.787 using a differently-sequenced draw). Upstream seed-42 output is reproducible bit-exactly, but the exact composition of the top-10 is seed-dependent — treat adjacent ranks as effectively tied.

Score spread is modest (0.001811-0.002418 vs 0.000371 uniform baseline, ~4.9x-6.5x baseline), consistent with mention-driven in-degree (Spearman 0.883 vs mention_count, 0.278 vs follower_count) rather than follower magnitude.

Robustness to the weight convention is high (alternative weight=mention_count on every edge: Spearman 0.985, 8/10 top-10 overlap); the cross-source engagement columns (retweets/likes) are present in full_ranking but do not enter the mandated output columns.
Minor upstream note: execute_summary claims validation 10/10 pass and matches this re-verification; the only unverifiable item is the exact seed-7 sensitivity variant (see above).
conclusion: output.csv is present, schema-exact, complete (10 rows, ranks 1-10), correctly rounded to 6 dp, its mention/follower values match source aggregation exactly, and the whole pipeline (join -> sampled directed graph -> weighted PageRank) reproduces to floating-point noise.
